headline: Blowout quarter, but priced for one
chart_note: 52-week range: $416.44 - $1,073.46. Currently $822.00, nearly double its 52-week low after a roughly 95% run over the past year.
why_today: Q2 revenue jumped 23.7% YoY to a record $20.5B, adjusted EPS beat estimates by 32%, and backlog surged to a record $72B - up 92% from a year earlier - prompting management to raise full-year guidance.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (19 analysts), though the average price target of $975.61 implies more moderate upside from here
pro_2: Record backlog with 59% deliverable in the next 12 months gives real revenue visibility
con_1: At 35x earnings after a 95% 12-month rally, this is priced for continued perfection, not just good results
con_2: Beta of 1.59 - among the more volatile names in this basket if the industrial cycle turns
